title: Imitation Policies Learn a Proprioceptive Anchor: A Predictive Law for Perception Noise and Its Closed Loop Cost
abstract: arXiv:2611.17658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Imitation policies for robot manipulation are often trained on noisy object positions, and they learn to discount the noisy reading. We show how much they discount it, and why. Because demonstrators steer toward the object, the robot's own state carries information about where the object is. A trained policy combines this proprioceptive anchor with the reading and weights the reading by $\alpha = V/(V + s^2)$, where $s^2$ is the reading noise and $V$ the anchor's error variance. $V$ belongs to the learner and is far smaller than a linear model of the demonstrations implies, which is why classical errors-in-variables (EIV) regression overestimates $\alpha$. translated_title: 模仿策略学习本体感知锚点：感知噪声及其闭环代价的预测定律
translated_abstract: 机器人操作的模仿策略通常在有噪声的物体位置读数上进行训练，它们学会对含噪读数进行折扣。我们展示了它们折扣的程度及其原因。由于演示者会朝物体方向移动，机器人自身的状态携带着物体位置的信息。训练好的策略将这一本体感知锚点与读数相结合，并以 α = V/(V + s²) 对读数加权，其中 s² 是读数噪声，V 是锚点的误差方差。V 属于学习器本身，远小于由演示数据建立的线性模型所暗示的值，这正是经典变量误差回归高估 α 的原因。V 只需测量一次，即可在两个 robomimic 任务、两个学习器和四个新噪声水平下预测十个保留样本的敏感度，平均绝对误差为 0.025，而经典 EIV 方法为 0.37；此外，一个无参数的偏差测试排除了更简单的解释，即策略只是单纯高估……
tldr: 该论文揭示了模仿策略会将机器人自身状态作为“本体感知锚点”来折扣含噪感知读数，其权重服从 α=V/(V+s²) 的预测定律，且锚点方差远小于线性模型暗示值，一次测量即可精确预测策略在不同任务和噪声水平下对感知噪声的敏感度。
en_tdlr: Imitation policies anchor noisy perception readings to the robot's proprioceptive state via a predictive weighting law α=V/(V+s²), whose anchor variance—far smaller than linear models imply—can be measured once to accurately predict policy sensitivity to perception noise across tasks, learners, and noise levels.
